title: fix(rest)!: apply an inline import mapping entry's transform, defaultValue and required
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDWJsBGQpadCH8JR2xZQ5re)_

Fixes #25491

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the import doors refuse two request shapes they used to run: an inline mapping entry declaring `transform: 'date_format'` (or a transform name outside the declared set), and an entry marked `required: true` whose column a row leaves blank. Nothing is widened.

Metadata-protocol: none (a REST import request's handling; nothing a metadata author writes changes)

## What changes

`ImportRequestSchema.mapping` accepts a `FieldMappingEntry[]` whose entries carry `transform`, `defaultValue` and `required`. `prepareImportRequest` (`packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts`) kept only each entry's column and field and dropped the rest, so the import ran with no transform. Each entry's rules now run on its column after the rows are built and before cell coercion, for every format (csv, json rows, xlsx) and for both doors that parse through this function (the sync import and the async import job):

- `trim` / `uppercase` / `lowercase` rewrite a string cell; `none` and `lookup` copy it (a lookup cell is still resolved to an id by the runner's reference resolution, as the named mapping's `lookup` is).
- `defaultValue` fills a blank cell (absent, empty, whitespace or one of `nullValues`, judged by core's `isBlank`, the predicate cell coercion uses).
- `required: true` with a cell still blank refuses the request `400 MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD` before any row, on the dry run and the commit alike, naming the column and the rows.
- `date_format`, and any name outside the declared set, refuses the request `400 UNSUPPORTED_TRANSFORM` naming the transform.

A plain `{ sourceField, targetField }` entry produces no rule and the row is built exactly as before.

## Measured before choosing the route

The dispatch asked to reuse what the named-mapping path does. Measured on `origin/main` `dc3e5b9d7b`: the named path (`applyMappingToRows`, `packages/core/src/utils/import-mapping.ts`) implements a different vocabulary, the `mapping` artifact's `none / constant / map / split / join / lookup` (and refuses `javascript`). `trim`, `uppercase`, `lowercase` and `date_format` are implemented nowhere in the tree (`git grep` over `packages`, tests excluded: the only hit is the spec enum), and no path implements an entry's `defaultValue` or `required`. So there was no shared implementation of these to hand the entries to, and this PR adds no second one: the three string transforms live in one table in `import-prepare.ts`; `none` and `lookup` keep the named path's semantics (copy, resolve downstream); the blank test reuses core's `isBlank`. No `packages/spec` change and no file outside `packages/rest`.

`date_format` is refused rather than applied: `FieldMappingEntry` carries no format for it, so it has no defined input. A date or datetime target is already parsed as a date by cell coercion, so the remedy is to drop the transform.

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/import-inline-mapping-entry.test.ts` drives the real `POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` route (real ObjectQL engine, protocol, sqlite `:memory:`):

- the card's reproduction: `uppercase` on the credit-code column passes a `^[0-9A-Z]{18}$` format rule and is stored upper-cased, under `writeMode: upsert` / `matchFields: ['credit_code']`;
- `lowercase` on an email column: `ZHOU@X.EXAMPLE.COM` then `zhou@x.example.com` under `matchFields: ['supplier', 'email']` leaves one contact (created 1, then updated 1);
- `trim` with `trimWhitespace: false`; `defaultValue` for a blank cell and a missing column; `required` refusal on the dry run and the commit with nothing written; `required` satisfied by a `defaultValue`; `date_format` refused `400 UNSUPPORTED_TRANSFORM`;
- control: a plain `{ sourceField, targetField }` mapping (and `transform: 'none'`) stores the cells untouched.

Ablation (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, source-resolved suite so no dist leg): flipping the guard `if (entryRules.length > 0) {` to a less-than-zero comparison (so the rules never run) turned 5 of 8 red (uppercase, lowercase, trim, defaultValue, required); the 3 that stay green are the parse-time `date_format` refusal, required-with-default and the control, as expected. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Local verification (head `b5a3141e7f`, base `dc3e5b9d7b`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/import-inline-mapping-entry.test.ts`: 8/8 passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (whole package): Test Files 322 passed, Tests 6616 passed / 344 skipped (VERDICT command-exit 0). Source unchanged since; the later commits touch only the changeset.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`, which compiles the new test file): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery (owed by the `!` title and the `(narrowing)` arm), on `b5a3141e7f`: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 290 passed / 3 skipped, Tests 2494 passed / 18 skipped.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: 67 derived, 65 run (all exit 0), 2 NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs a whole-workspace build) and `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (exit 3: its closure build waits on the verify lock, which a sibling's dogfood run held past the wait budget). Both run in CI.
- `pnpm lint`: NOT MEASURED repo-wide (the verify lock was held by a sibling's 28-minute run past three wait budgets); narrowed and declared: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the two changed source files, exit 0. CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs the repo-wide sweep.
- `origin/main` moved 11 commits since the base; none touches `packages/rest`, `packages/core/src/utils` or the spec's import schema, and `git merge-tree` against it is clean, so no merge was taken.

## Acceptance notes

- A `required` miss refuses the whole request rather than failing only the offending rows: the runner (`packages/core`) has no seam for a pre-failed row, and giving it one is outside this card's file surface. The refusal names every row, so the operator fixes the file once.
- The `import-mapping.ts` docblock still describes the inline mapping as a plain rename; it is accurate for the compact record form and for plain entries.
